commit_message: Integrate Goose ACP with Managed Local lease
pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate the provider-neutral ACP core transport and AgentHost bridge
- add Claude and Codex ACP adapters on the common process transport
- add Goose Managed Local as a common-transport ACP adapter with exact model/runtime endpoint leases
- carry the existing AgentRun-bound MCP identity header through common ACP HTTP MCP configuration
- keep Agent Host authoritative for permissions, MCP writes, validation, and completion

## Integration

AI Studio execution routing, benchmark migration, Cargo.lock, and final validation continue on this Draft integration branch.

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is required after this integration slice; the final integrated head is authoritative.
